summary.headline: Emcure Q1 FY27 revenue rose 22.8% YoY to INR 2,580 crore, with EBITDA of INR 508 crore (19.7% margin) and PAT up 35-36%.
summary.overview:
Revenue grew 22.8% YoY to INR 2,580 crore, led by international markets (up 34.2% to INR 1,485 crore) while India grew 10.2% to INR 1,095 crore. EBITDA rose 25.8% to INR 508 crore with margin up 50 bps to 19.7%, and PAT grew about 36% to INR 292 crore. Gross margin fell to 58.4% on geographic and product mix, and net debt rose to INR 1,103 crore. Management reiterated low-to-mid teens FY27 revenue growth (now toward the higher end) and 70-100 bps EBITDA margin expansion. Board changes were announced: Chairman Berjis Desai retires at AGM and CEO Satish Mehta becomes Chairman; Samit Mehta becomes COO and CEO of Gennova, which is now 100% owned.</overview>

segments.name: India
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 1,095 crore, +10.2% YoY. Ex-Sanofi OAD and Roche in-licensed brands, growth was about 6-7%. Price contributed about 4-5%, new launches 1-2%. Management says no channel filling in the quarter.

segments.name: Europe
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 537 crore, +32.8% YoY, driven by base business and liposomal amphotericin B (Ampho). Ampho is introduced in pretty much all countries, but tender-based procurement means lumpy orders.

segments.name: Canada
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 427 crore, +24.6% YoY, on new launches and share gains. Semaglutide filing expected in the next few months; Quebec launch via Dr. Reddy's is uncertain.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 522 crore, +44.8% YoY, led by ARV. About two-thirds of ROW was ARV this quarter; management expects ARV at about 50-55% of ROW for the full year.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at low-to-mid teens, with management now more comfortable at the higher end of that range, driven by ARV order book visibility.
EBITDA margin expansion of 70-100 bps for FY27 reiterated.
FY27 gross margin guided at about 59% (earlier 60-61% framing), as higher international and ARV mix dilutes gross margin while EBITDA is accretive.
R&D for FY27 guided at 4-5% of revenue; spend expected to pick up in the rest of the year.
India growth expected in line with industry in Q2 FY27 and faster than industry in H2 FY27 as the Zuventus base effect eases.
Net debt expected to rise to about INR 1,450 crore by end-Q2 FY27 after the Mantra and Gennova payouts (INR 450-500 crore), then turn net cash by end-FY28.
Management expects sequential improvement each quarter.
capex_capacity: No capacity, utilisation or capex figures were given on the call.
Gennova consolidated to 100% after acquiring a 12.05% minority stake; Mantra acquisition payout completed in July 2026.
demand_pricing: International constant-currency growth about 12% (about 12-13% per later answer), against about 6-7% FX tailwind at company level.
India price growth about 4-5% YoY; new launches 1-2%; the remainder is volume.

Poviztra (semaglutide biosimilar with Novo Nordisk) is growing month on month, but management says 40-50 brands have launched in the market and it is hard to separate channel stocking from consumption. Pricing was set very competitively.
Gross margin pressure reflects B2B-type international businesses (lower gross margin, higher EBITDA contribution), with Europe and ARV growing faster.
Management says Zuventus is stabilised and consolidated, now moving to acceleration.

qa_highlights.question: Is India's double-digit growth clean, or is there channel filling after Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no channel filling this quarter; growth is normalised and expected to improve further in coming quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What share of ROW is ARV, and does FY27 base make FY28 harder?
qa_highlights.answer: About two-thirds of ROW is ARV this quarter; full-year ARV share is expected at about 50-55% of ROW, with growth in both ARV and non-ARV.

qa_highlights.question: When will domestic growth be back in line with the market, and what is organic growth ex-in-licensed brands?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 FY27 is expected to be in line with industry and H2 faster. Ex-Sanofi OAD and Roche, growth was about 6-7%. Poviztra is a new launch; OAD moves into the base next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What is constant-currency international growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Company-level FX impact was about 6-7%; international growth would have been about 12% in constant currency (12-13% in later answer).

qa_highlights.question: Why is Canada semaglutide a second-wave filing, and what is the Quebec launch timing with Dr. Reddy's?
qa_highlights.answer: Filing expected in the next few months, delayed because semaglutide was pursued as a global development. Quebec timing depends on Dr. Reddy's supply; management will defer to them.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin decline and where does it settle?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix from Europe and ARV growth; FY27 gross margin guided at about 59%. Management says B2B international businesses are EBITDA-accretive despite lower gross margin.

qa_highlights.question: When will net debt turn to net cash and how does it trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt expected at about INR 1,450 crore by end-Q2 after acquisition payouts; net cash by about end-FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY27 R&D spend?
qa_highlights.answer: R&D is guided at 4-5% of revenue for FY27.
